company.name: Forage
company.shortDescription: Forage is a payments technology company that enables merchants to accept SNAP EBT and EBT Cash payments.
company.description: Forage is a payments technology company that enables merchants to accept SNAP EBT and EBT Cash payments through online and in-store channels. The company provides APIs, SDKs, checkout components, and certification support that help retailers integrate government benefit payment processing into their existing commerce platforms. Its platform includes payment processing, fraud protection, transaction analytics, and merchant management tools designed to support benefit-based transactions. In addition to merchant services, Forage offers consumer-focused solutions that help shoppers access and use government assistance benefits for grocery purchases. The company focuses on expanding access to digital payment options for benefit recipients while supporting retailers that serve these customers.
